name: @estebanforge/pi-egm
description: Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) for Pi: Google's spec-driven development skills. /egm-brainstorm stress-tests ideas with zero-context Goldfish reviewers, /egm-draft turns the brief into a design doc, /egm-review runs the five-stage Goldfish review, plus resolve, bootstrap, and drift-report. Vendored from google/elephant-goldfish-model (Apache-2.0) with Pi dispatch notes; Goldfish reviewers run in fresh isolated child sessions spawned by the bundled egm_goldfish tool.
